info.prompt: Cyber-alchemical lab: macro shot of a {wild blocker tile|rainbow-hue die} mid-chain, its W symbol emitting {neon particles|data sparks}, surrounded by {stone blockers|ice locks} cracking under pressure, the board's {golden gridlines|neon wireframes} distorting as if viewed through warped glass, {terminal error messages|encrypted glyphs} flickering at the edges, {deep purple|toxic green} shadows pooling in the skeletal framework's recesses.
